statements.conclusions: A iff B; both directions, curvature and dimension.

statements.hypotheses: B; bounded global Lipschitz u constant off compact set; every nonnegative compact Lipschitz f; compact test gradient Z; 0<delta<1; smooth finite temporal combinations with global endpoints.
statements.conclusions: Common Borel calibrated path prescription independent of f,Z,trial; bounded speed and positive-time compression; index inequality.

statements.checking: 原典の仮定・量化・結論を日英主張欄と照合
statements.hypotheses: B; each p; R_kappa sqrt(kappa)<pi/2 for kappa>0; each compact test gradient.
statements.conclusions: Signed Radon Hessian measure, nonpositive singular part, radial/transverse comparison, |grad q|=r a.e., center-independent radius.

statements.checking: 原典の仮定・量化・結論を日英主張欄と照合

proofPassages.read: Short-flow equations, configuration inequality, density variation, dual energy identity, square completion and order of endpoint-correction limit.
Finite local gradient approximation, signed coefficient measures, local strong second derivatives, global cutoff tail.
Positive terminal data, heat factors, density/lower Laplacian estimates, weighted second order estimates, exact inverse-viscosity cancellation, singular Bochner measure treatment.
Logarithmic heat limit, W2 continuity before continuity-equation criterion, moment tails, action sandwich, weighted strong velocity convergence and terminal-density-independent path prescription.
Splitting maps, rank-defect content, polar and H^(n−1)-null avoidance, Deng tangent continuity, finite-dimensional ODE, parallel velocity and countable global trials.
Radial Hopf–Lax data, terminal gradient trace, Riesz measure extraction, countable infimum, Jacobi energy, delta limit.
Companion hypotheses, bounded monotone distance modification, model ODE, local four-point and global CBB, dimension.
